shortDescription: German business morale grew more than expected in September, a survey showed on Thursday.The Ifo institute said its business climate index rose to 89.9 in September from 88.8 in August.Analysts polled by Reuters had forecast an increase to 89.0.

children: German business morale grew more than expected in September, a survey showed on Thursday.
The Ifo institute said its business climate index rose to 89.9 in September from 88.8 in August.
Analysts polled by Reuters had forecast an increase to 89.0.
